brief:
Brazil's former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has defeated incumbent Jair Bolsonaro in a closely watched rematch, Drop Site News reported. The victory ends Bolsonaro's first term after years of polarization between the leftist and far-right camps.

Israel has expelled more than 3,100 Palestinians from Hebron, the news outlet reported. The expulsions represent a major displacement operation in the contested West Bank city.

A student-led movement has defeated Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić, according to Drop Site News. The outcome signals a challenge to the long-governing leader's political dominance in the Balkans.
title: Lula defeats Bolsonaro in Brazilian election rematch
